capabilities: Preview vault HTML files in an isolated iframe
Switch render width between desktop, tablet, and mobile presets
Reload the preview when the file changes on disk
Embed previews in notes with html-preview code blocks
Open files in the system browser
extras: Manifest carries the unreviewed-plugin notice. README warns that only one view can own the .html extension, so conflicting HTML-rendering plugins like HTML Reader must be disabled, and that strict isolation trades localStorage and relative file loading for a sandboxed opaque origin.
motivation: The author explains that DOM-injecting plugins leak prototype CSS into Obsidian's interface and must block scripts, so loading files in an iframe avoids both problems.
problem: Other HTML-preview plugins inject HTML into Obsidian's DOM, leaking global CSS into the app and blocking scripts, so prototypes do not render or run correctly.
summary: Previews local HTML files in an isolated iframe with device widths and live reload, and embeds previews in notes via html-preview blocks.
